source: CTR boundary reporting points, per airfield, given by the maintainer (2026-08). These are the points where the route clock starts on departure: the climb-out from the field to the boundary is flown on the field's procedure, not on the route's stopwatch, so it is excluded from the cumulative time. Not a published dataset and not an airspace boundary -- a list of the points a pilot actually starts counting from.
_note: Add an airfield by listing its boundary reporting points. An airfield absent from this list behaves exactly as before: the clock starts at the field.
